branched_from: agent/r3-release-classifier-defaults, not master -- R4 builds directly on classify() as R3 leaves it, and R3 is not merged yet. Flagged rather than hidden.
what: needs_human had no exit: a ? row could only be cleared by editing code, so the gate was red forever for any binary figure rendering a per-game label. R4 adds a hash-pinned, append-only human ruling path so the red means 'red until somebody rules' instead of 'red until somebody gives up'.
why_zero: A ruling is a signature. monitor/CHARTER.md routes anything needing human identity to needs_human. The agent that built the mechanism is the last party who should sign the rulings that turn its own gate green. Evidence and ready-to-sign lines are in release/RULINGS_PROPOSED.md; release/verify.sh stays RED.
